text: Because blockchain guarantees prevent any participant from circumventing the coded set of governance rules, a lower level of oversight and monitoring of agents is needed, which changes the cost structure of the principal agent relationship.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904
